An '''infochip''' was a data storage medium. [[Puln]], a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] in [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Green]]'s organization, smuggled information to Vigo [[Sprax]] by smuggling the chip embedded in the magazine of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
